d: A 30-year-old man named Nabeel allegedly attacked nine Delhi Police personnel with a knife in two separate incidents on Monday. The first attack took place inside Jama Masjid Police Station, where he had been called for counselling following a complaint by his mother and sister. After fleeing the police station, he allegedly snatched a scooter and attacked four more policemen when they tried to arrest him in the Chitli Qabar area.
